A LETTER FOR THE PRINCESS

Dear Sumi,

Somewhere between ordinary conversations and unexpected smiles, you became one of the loveliest parts of my days.

I don't know what all the tomorrows have written for us. I'd just like to meet them with an open heart, one little moment at a time.

Thank you for the way you laugh, the way you listen, and the way you make even an uneventful evening feel like a memory worth keeping.

Until then, keep being wonderfully, unmistakably you.

With warmth,
Madhava ♡

P.S. You're allowed to read this more than once, Princess.
